verdict.rationale: No official documentation in the evidence pack describes System Restore or update rollback features; the only relevant evidence is a community report that 'F8 + last known good configuration' helped recover from a boot loop after a bad update, which is a related but distinct recovery mechanism rather than a documented snapshot/restore-point feature. missing for 10: official docs on System Restore/restore points, Windows Update uninstall/rollback documentation, independent confirmation the snapshot mechanism reliably restores a broken system.
